name: Buffalo Shrimp Flatbread with Blue Cheese & Pickled Veggie Salad

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar and salt in a small bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium carrot
1 stick celery
½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve carrot lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place shrimp in a medium bowl along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp cornstarch
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp and cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat, add hot sauce, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp hot sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl, then whisk to combine the dressing. Add pickled veggies and arugula, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Top each flatbread with a small handful of the arugula salad, spicy shrimp, and blue cheese. Slice into wedges. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Divide flatbreads between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
